newsitem.title: GERMANY: Commerzbank keeps Deutsche Telekom on hold.
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank keeps Deutsche Telekom on hold.

text.p: Commerzbank AG said on Monday it was maintaining its recommendation of "hold" on shares in telecommunications group Deutsche Telekom AG and urged the company to make a statement about 1996 earnings.
Analyst Sabine Schauer told Reuters she regretted that fact that Telekom did not plan to comment on its earnings last year until a routine news conference on May 13.
"There are no new data on the company," she said. "This is really astounding in the days of shareholder value and in light of the advertising hype ahead of the issue."
Schauer said she expected Telekom shares to trade "sideways" in a range of 30-32 marks.
